eli: Huge shoutout to @marco and Partner Ops for sprinting down to the loading dock when the swag pallet went off-schedule ":pray:
marco: Team effort
We found the driver stuck behind a delivery of office plants, redirected the truck, and saved the morning demo boxes :package:
partnerships: Appreciate Facilities jumping in to unblock access and the warehouse team for staying late to scan everything. Saved us a scramble before the customer visit :clap:
facilities: No problem
We propped the door, moved some planters, and borrowed a pallet jack from storage. All in a day's work :wrench:
warehouse-bot: Scan log: 18 crates scanned and staged at desk area. (scan complete)
eli: if anyone sees a heroic face, ping People Ops so we can send a thank-you gift. Also pizza or bagels to celebrate? react with :one: for pizza, :two: for bagels, :three: for iced lattes
people-ops: We'll send a small care package and a handwritten card to Facilities + Partnerships. DM me names to add to the note :mailbox_with_mail:
marco: thanks everyone. also shoutout to @warehouse-bot for the timely scan alerts that let us track the shipment :robot_face:
stickerbot: Sticker awarded: "Swag Saviors" to partnerships and facilities :sparkles:
eli: tiny poll result so far looks like :one: pizza lead. Meeting saved, snacks incoming :pizza:
